title: Casey Bus Consultation
articleDescription: Have your say and help shape our plans for better buses in your local area.
articleContent:
We've developed plans to improve bus services across Casey, including Cranbourne, Clyde, Berwick, Botanic Ridge, Junction Village, Tooradin, Warneet and surrounding areas, to support growing communities.

We’re proposing changes to bus routes 795, 796, 836, 846, 888, 897, 899, and introducing new Route 896 connecting Lynbrook Station and Casey Fields via Merinda Park and Cranbourne stations.

The proposed changes would:

  • provide faster, more direct and frequent bus services
  • improve public transport access for more than 130,000 people
  • bring buses to new estates in parts of Cranbourne East and Clyde for the first time
  • make it easier to connect to trains, jobs, education, health services and shopping.

For more information and have your say, visit Engage Victoria. 

Consultation closes on Monday 19 October 2026.

You can also speak to us at a pop-up session near you:

Tuesday 6 October 2026

  • 12 pm – 1 pm: Coles Botanic Ridge, Botanic Ridge  
  • 2:30 pm – 3:30 pm: Cranbourne Station, Cranbourne
  • 4:30 pm – 5:30 pm: Berwick Station, Berwick

Monday 12 October 2026

  • 11 am – 12 pm: Tooradin Foodworks, Tooradin  
  • 1:30 pm – 2:30 pm: Cranbourne Park Shopping Centre (near NAB), Cranbourne
  • 3:30 pm – 4:30 pm: Eden Rise Village (near Coles), Berwick

You can arrive at any time during the pop-up session to chat to a member of the team.

Your feedback will help us plan and provide bus services that better meet the public transport needs of the area.
